structs.name: BulletFireParams
structs.size_evidence: not proven. Lower bound 180: G_Weapon_BuildBulletFireParams@0x1411d4f20 writes raw byte [v8+179] (|= 1 and |= 2) and [v8+178] (isAltFire), so the object is at least 180 bytes. Upper bound 192 candidate: G_Weapon_FireBulletShot@0x1411d19e0 builds its object as the stack local rbp-0xD8..rbp-0x18 (shooter[8] = 128 bytes, then qwords v17..v24 zeroed in one block = 192 bytes); that block may hold more than this struct. IDA 184 (shooter 128 + v17 + v18..v23) sits inside the bounds but is not proven. Game-test 160 is refuted (accesses to +179).

structs.notes: The packet's replay_max_access_end 72 is outdated: BuildBulletFireParams writes to +179. Object origin: G_Weapon_FireBulletShot copies shotParams (128 bytes plus the qword at +128) into its local, zeroes the rest, and passes that local to BuildBulletFireParams (as fireParams) and then to G_Weapon_FireBulletTrace, which passes it to G_Weapon_TraceBulletSegment as trace. So the first bytes of the struct are a copy of the shot record; that is why the copy is 136 bytes. Verdict partial: the struct is real and Replay-used (queue, count, start/end/dir, travelDistance, +140..+179 writes), but the size is not proven.

structs.name: BestHostData
structs.size_evidence: not proven. Parent: MigrateData at PartyData+8 (MigrateData base confirmed by raw party+16 indexBits, party+20 startTime, party+24 timeoutDuration, party+28 partyTime, party+32 lastBroadcastTime, party+36 expectedNewHost, party+40 migrateToRequestedHost in PartyMigrate_Frame@0x1411a4210 and PartyMigrate_NewHostDecided@0x1411a58d0). bestHost is at MigrateData+36 = party+44. Replay reads a timestamp at party+80 (bestHost+36) in PartyMigrate_Frame: a 44-byte BestHostData puts lastHeardFrom there, a 40-byte one (NomineeInfo 28 bytes) would put lastSentTo there. So the size is 40 or 44, decided by NomineeInfo's size (owned by A093; its hostScore at +24 is raw-proven, its size is not). Bounds: 40 <= size <= 44.

structs.notes: Not absent: the migrate code uses bestHost's info block as the decided host's data. Partial until NomineeInfo's Replay size is settled (A093 owns it). BulletFireParams is not related. PartyMigrate_SelectBestHostCandidate, PartyMigrate_DetermineBestHost_FilterByPing and PartyMigrate_DetermineBestHost_LogResults use the PartyMember 488-byte stride and NomineeInfo at member+184 (migrateNomineeInfo), not BestHostData; they do not prove BestHostData's size. LogResults' best-host number is party+311052 (= partyId), not bestHost.

structs.name: AnalyticsBuffer
structs.size_evidence: not proven. No Replay function uses an AnalyticsBuffer by name, type or stride. Replay does have analytics streamer dvars: online_analytics_streamer_upload_min_delay_ms (default 1000) and the upload failure count max (default 10), registered in Live_RegisterCommonDvars@0x141590eb0 into s_Live_commonDvar_14EE56198 and s_Live_commonDvar_14EE561A0. Those two globals have no reader in the database (only the write in Live_RegisterCommonDvars), so the upload function that would use them was not found. The builder 16808 is not supported; 16784 (IDA and game-test) is consistent with the member list but is unproven.
unconfirmed: m_data (+0), m_writeOffset (+8), m_flushState (+12), m_uploadFileWriteInfo (+16, 16760 bytes, pooledStorageWriteFileInfo, owned by A116), m_nextStreamUploadAttemptTime (+16776), m_uploadFailureCount (+16780): no Replay access found
